client_brief:
Athlete cards and spotlight portraits for our gym opening

Anvil & Oak needs opening-roster cards and a consistent portrait set. Sixteen members were photographed across three evenings, and the colour differences are obvious when the portraits sit on our dark ground.

Please work from the barbell club's press artwork for the cards. Names, quotes and performance figures must follow the supplied records, with one stated basis for the three figures rather than an improvised mix.

CARD RUN
One 5 by 7 card per rostered athlete who is in, card count equal to the reconciled roster, binding name, three figures on a single stated basis, level, coach and quote verbatim. Accompanied by one single-card file per athlete, named to the roster and identity-verified by opening it, and by proofs rendered at true print-resolution from the merged document. Produced by reverse-engineering the barbell club's press file into a live merge template, so the template and the record of what the conversion actually exposed are handed back.

PORTRAIT SET
Sixteen portraits shot across three evenings at three colour temperatures brought to one temperature, one black point and one degree of modelling, judged against the dark ground they will sit on, then derived into the square, four by five and tall formats under one crop logic. Every output at or below its source dimensions, with a per-athlete parameter log, a note of which frames had their edges extended and why, and any athlete who could not be brought to the set named.

We provide wall_mark.jpg (approx 4000 x 3000); athlete_portraits/ (16 frames, three evenings, mixed dimensions); meetcard_press.pdf; roster_and_numbers.csv; coach_notes.txt.

Please check the crop logic across square, four-by-five and tall placements before exporting everything. Where an edge is extended, explain why. We would rather know that one member's photograph is unsuitable than publish an obviously weaker card beside the rest.

Please deliver a delivery manifest, the editable sources specified above, final exports, a short production and exceptions note and the normalised data and field-mapping record. Account for every supplied file and identify anything used only as reference, superseded or rejected. Stay with approved facts and copy. Do not silently replace weak assets; use only the stated stock or concept allowances, and record omissions, substitutions, reconciliations and material compromises.

Budget: $3,000-$7,000 fixed. Target: 2 to 4 weeks. Reviews: One direction checkpoint and two consolidated revision rounds. New deliverable classes, new source creation, extra records, and client copy changes after approval are quoted separately.

source_provenance.statement: The scenario is synthesized from the repository's laundered Upwork and Freelancer source anchors. It is not represented as a verbatim live listing.
source_provenance.original_anchor: Primary anchor: the recurring Upwork gym-launch posting in which an owner opening a new studio asks for 'a class schedule poster for the wall, a membership deck we use at the front desk, and social posts for Instagram, all in our branding', explicitly noting that they have 'no logo file, only a photo of the sign' and that the schedule 'changes every season so we need to be able to edit it ourselves'. Co-anchor: the Freelancer.com posting from a barbell and powerlifting club needing 'individual athlete result cards, one per lifter, print ready, from the template our old designer made', with only the printed PDF surviving and a spreadsheet of names and numbers supplied alongside. Both real clients, their gyms and their coaches are laundered to the fictional Anvil and Oak. The ledger's STRENGTHEN verdict was right that the concept as banked leaned on authoring alone: the fuller commission this client genuinely has starts at a photograph of a hand-painted mark and sixteen inconsistent portraits, runs through a real record-per-page card run inherited from a printer who is gone, and only then reaches the poster, the deck and the spotlight set that all have to carry the same recovered mark identically.

price_band_and_audience: Memberships at a hundred and ten to a hundred and eighty five dollars a month with a twenty eight dollar drop in, sold to twenty five to forty five year olds who are choosing coached strength work over a commodity gym and who read programming detail as evidence of competence. The band is load-bearing in both directions. At this price the correct grammar is confident and specific: a dark ground, cinematic portraits with real modelling on the shoulders and forearms, a schedule grid that shows level and coach rather than mood words, tier cards that state exactly what is included, and heavy condensed display type held in check by a plain workhorse text face. Softened into the pale, airy, thin-serif register of a boutique wellness studio it misreads the audience completely and reads as a place where nobody lifts anything heavy. Pushed the other way into shouted percentages, burst callouts and a discount-first hierarchy it becomes a chain gym promotion, which directly undercuts a price roughly double what the chains charge and tells a prospective member the coaching is not what they are paying for. A real posted commission of this shape runs 1,200 to 2,800 dollars fixed.

assets_supplied.name: wall_mark.jpg (approx 4000 x 3000)
assets_supplied.kind: A photograph of the hand-painted studio mark on the raw brick wall of the new space, shot slightly off square in evening light: an anvil silhouette, a ring of lettering around it, and an oak sprig crossing the anvil's horn.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "The mark our sign painter put on the brick. It is all we have."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: It is a compound lockup, and a selection aimed at it comes back plausible while quietly dropping one of its three elements, most often the sprig, which is thin and crosses the anvil. The enclosed counters inside the ring lettering are interior holes rather than outside edges, so a background removal returns an opaque patch of brick where the counters should be see-through.

assets_supplied.name: athlete_portraits/ (16 frames, three evenings, mixed dimensions)
assets_supplied.kind: Portraits of the opening roster shot by the coaches themselves over three evenings in the old shared space, on a mix of a camera and a phone.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "We shot these ourselves over three evenings. They are not consistent and we know it."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: The three evenings sit at three different colour temperatures and two of them carry a green cast off the shared space's overhead tubes. Five frames are near-square captures that cannot reach the tall story format at native scale, and on two frames a loaded barbell crosses the subject at shoulder height so a subject selection takes it in on one frame and cuts through it on the other.

assets_supplied.name: meetcard_press.pdf
assets_supplied.kind: The barbell club's flat press PDF for the post-meet athlete card, 5 by 7 inches portrait, fonts embedded, produced from a real page layout so it converts cleanly. Carries the lifter's name, three stat lines, a quote line, the club crest and a tinted panel where the printed card shows the lifter's photograph.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "The card our printer set up. We only have what went to press and he is not doing this any more."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: The crest and the panel behind the printed photograph were both drawn as artwork in the original layout rather than placed as images, so what the conversion exposes as addressable structure bears no relation to how the printed card is visually blocked out. Which of the printed lines are separately addressable and which share a single continuous flow cannot be inferred from looking at the card.

assets_supplied.name: roster_and_numbers.csv
assets_supplied.kind: The opening roster export from the club's spreadsheet, one row per athlete, with columns for name, three lift figures, level, coach and a quote line.
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: Three faults, none stated. One athlete asked to be left out after the export was taken and the request sits in the coaches' notes file rather than in the spreadsheet. The lift figures are a mix of kilograms and pounds with no unit column, so two athletes appear to be far stronger than they are. And two quote lines run to several times the length of the rest.

assets_supplied.name: coach_notes.txt
assets_supplied.kind: A page from the two coaches on how the programming actually works, what each class level means, and a few lines about the roster.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "How the programming works and what the levels mean."

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the recovered mark still holds where it is actually reproduced. The tracer takes no options at all, so everything about how the mark comes out is decided by the raster that goes in, and what comes back reads correctly at the size it was traced. On a hand-painted mark the ring lettering's counters and the gap between the oak sprig and the anvil's horn are narrow and irregular, and at the size the mark sits in a story canvas corner or a card footer, on the studio's dark ground rather than the pale field it was traced against, those counters can close up and the sprig can weld itself to the anvil. Nothing reports this. The artwork is valid, it places, it scales, and the failure exists only in what a person sees at reproduction size on the real ground.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: Ordering cannot avoid it, because the mark must exist before it can be placed, and care cannot settle it, because the tracer exposes no threshold, no path simplification and no colour count, so there is no parameter to get right in advance. Nothing in the brief, the assets or the deliverables states that the mark has narrow counters or a tight gap; the client only states that the mark must hold at every size, which is their requirement rather than a disclosure. The response is not a re-run of the trace, it is a return to the raster preparation with a different bound and a different polarity, or an authored small-size variant of the mark, which is a design decision about what the mark is allowed to lose.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Go back into the raster preparation and re-isolate the mark on a bound that keeps the counters open, re-trace and re-repair the artwork, and if the counters still close at the smallest reproduction, author a deliberate small-size variant, then re-place both at every size on the dark ground and record which size the full lockup stops holding at so the studio knows where the line is.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: A studio whose entire identity is one mark launches with that mark reading as a solid blob in the corner of every story post and at the foot of every athlete card, which is the one thing the client explicitly asked to be protected against and the thing every member will see most often.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether an extended frame can join the set. Five portraits are near-square captures that cannot reach the tall story format at native scale, so the only sanctioned route is to extend the frame's edges and crop into the result. What that extension actually builds is not knowable before it runs: it invents continuation from what is at the edge, and on a portrait shot in a cluttered shared space the invented edge can be a plausible wall that is nonetheless a different value and a different temperature from the graded set, or it can carry a smear where a rack upright ran off the frame. The call succeeds, returns a seed, and produces an image that looks entirely reasonable in isolation, on its own, at preview scale.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: No ordering avoids it, because the frames that need extending are exactly the frames that cannot reach the format any other way, and enlargement is barred. Care cannot settle it either: nothing about a frame predicts what its edges will generate, and the same call on two portraits from the same evening can behave differently. Nothing in the brief or the assets says which frames are short or what sits at their edges, and the acceptance line about invented edges is the client's standing quality bar. The response is a composition decision rather than a re-run: extend from a different side, crop tighter and lose some of the athlete, or take that athlete out of the tall format and give them the square and four by five only.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Lay each extended frame against the graded set on the dark ground at full size rather than judging it alone at preview scale, and where the invented edge does not match, re-extend from a different side or accept a tighter crop, re-derive that athlete's spotlight canvases from the corrected master, and if no route works, drop that athlete from the tall format and say so rather than shipping a frame with an invented wall in it.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: The studio's launch story posts go out with five athletes standing in front of a wall that does not exist, in a value and a temperature that visibly disagree with the eleven portraits beside them, which reads to a prospective member as a cheaply faked photograph and undercuts a price roughly double what a chain gym charges.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: What the club's card actually exposes as addressable structure. The printed card reads as four separate blocks plus a crest and a photograph, but the crest and the panel behind the photograph were drawn as artwork rather than placed as images, and the printer's text blocks may or may not have been built as separate frames. Which lines are separately addressable, which share one continuous flow, and whether any graphic frame exists at all that a per-athlete portrait could be bound to, is a property of a document nobody involved has ever opened. The conversion reports success either way and the mapping readout will happily describe a structure that is nothing like the printed page.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: Ordering cannot avoid it, because the document has to be converted before it can be inspected, and no amount of study of the printed card predicts its internal construction. Nothing in the brief, the assets or the deliverables states how the printer built it; the client only says the printer set it up and is gone. It is not a propagation re-run, because if there is no graphic frame the portraits cannot be bound into the card at all, and the response is a re-plan of what the card is: a text-only merge run with the portraits carried into the spotlight set instead, put to the coaches as a change to what they asked for rather than decided silently.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Read the exported interchange file's real frame inventory before authoring any mapping, build the mapping against the structure that is actually there rather than the structure the printed card suggests, and if no frame can carry a per-athlete photograph, re-plan the card as a text run, deliver the portraits in a form the studio can use, and tell the coaches plainly why the card cannot hold the picture the old one appeared to hold.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: The studio ships an opening-roster card run built on an imagined structure: fields mapped into frames that do not hold them, a portrait bound to nothing, and cards that come back looking like the old club card with lines missing or in the wrong place, discovered only when the coaches hand them to the members they were made for.
